}}'''Yarin Maeldan''' was [[Bayle Domon|Bayle Domon's]] first mate on the ''[[Spray]]''.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Yarin Maeldan}}

== Appearance ==
Yarin Maeldan is a stork-like man with a long nose. Judging by his speech, he is not an [[Illianer]], like his captain.

== Activities ==
He informs Domon on [[Carn]]'s death. They leave [[Illian]] and sail for [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|2|9}} While sailing, they are boarded by [[Egeanin Tamarath]] and her crew and forced to sail into [[Falme]].{{ref/book|2|29}} Later, Domon promises to take [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] out of Falme. Yarin and Domon are in port ready to sail the ''Spray'' when lightning begins to light up in the sky and the sea goes mad. Yarin says that they have to sail immediatly, but Domon waits for as long as he can before sailing away without Nynaeve.{{ref/book|2|45}}{{ref/book|2|46}} It is unknown what has happend to Yarin after Bayle was made ''[[da'covale]]'', however his death would be something about which Domon would have spoken.
